title: SFHQ-InstantID Dataset Schema
description: Schema for dataset.csv / dataset.parquet and dataset_imbalanced.csv / dataset_imbalanced.parquet

image_path.description: Release-relative path to the 224x224 face crop, e.g. processed/images/identity_037/accepted_012.jpg

forget_step.description: Unlearning step when this identity is deleted; -1 for non-forget

forget_variant.description: Variant index within a forget step; -1 for non-forget

arcface_similarity.description: Cosine similarity to identity's mean ArcFace embedding (confound control)

laplacian_variance.description: Sharpness score from quality filter (quality confound control)

notes.balanced: dataset.csv / dataset.parquet — exactly 75 images per identity, all base columns
notes.imbalanced: dataset_imbalanced.csv / dataset_imbalanced.parquet — 85:40:20 gradient, adds popularity_bin + images_per_identity
notes.image_size: 224x224 uint8 BGR JPEG stored as accepted_XXX.jpg
